correctness.rationale: Derived missing t-sets form S(t-1,t,v-1). For covered t-anchors, all outside points fall into exactly one old-block completion, t distinct missing-completion choices, and v-2t-2 free choices; for missing t-anchors all v-t-1 choices have one fixed missing subset. These supports yield permanent FO^(t+1) pebble-game strategies separately for full, small punctured and larger punctured phases. Two explicit width-(t+1) formulas separate the three phases, with bound variable reuse checked. Width t sees only false repeated-argument block atoms and equality. Two independent finite calculations match these structural steps; no extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: Natural all-strength Steiner hypergraphs admit a complete sharp fixed-variable logical spectrum, uniform across all designs and arbitrarily large orders. The exceptional threshold v=2t+2 is forced by the exact t+1 distinguished extension points. The result connects combinatorial uniqueness/one-point residual designs with expressiveness limits and extends beyond the known triple-system special case to all strengths and punctured quadruple systems.
